name: train-only-scorer-O-point-ray-uniqueness-gate
status: Math/protocol review proposal only; no new scorer-native true-psi read, ray calculation, log-radius PCA or model fit before root approval
question: Can the scorer-native magnetic O-point serve as one physically fixed polar origin for every true diverted LCFS in the existing TRAIN-only probe sample, where the polygon centroid failed on four genuine concavities?

distinct_prior.interpretation: The centroid-origin half-bin ray gate failed on four of 153,600 rays in four TRAIN frames, each with three non-endpoint polygon intersections. Changing only the physically distinguished origin to the magnetic O-point is a separate predeclared family, not a reclassification or tolerance change for those rays.

sample.selection: Reuse exactly the previously frozen first 100 compact TRAIN filenames and q=0.1/0.5/0.9 frame indices. No validation1338 or original salt-0 evaluation70 file or label may enter this gate. Check the pinned dataset manifest and every selected parquet SHA before reading true psi.

origin_and_ray_construction.true_contour: Extract the same scorer-native true 512-point physical (R,Z) LCFS from each selected efit_psirz frame with the frozen DIII-D scorer and envelope mask. Do not use stored efit_lcfs_* boundary. Missing/non-simple true contour is a hard source feasibility error with shot/frame context.
origin_and_ray_construction.O_point: For each true psi map, compute (R_axis,Z_axis) using the frozen scorer's derive.magnetic_axis(psi_true,R,Z,'DIII-D',mask_coarse,axis_sign=None). This scorer-native subpixel O-point is a TRAIN target used only to define a representation chart; a future direct model must predict the O-point from permitted features. Neither true O-point nor any current best11 predicted axis/map may be a learner input or residual target.
origin_and_ray_construction.inside: Require frozen scorer even-odd point-in-polygon(O_point,C_true) and minimum Euclidean distance from O_point to every true contour segment strictly greater than tau. Outside/on-contour or nonfinite O-point is a recorded frame failure, never a switch to the true centroid or another origin.
origin_and_ray_construction.rays: Reuse exactly the centroid v2 construction except for origin: 512 global directions theta_j=2*pi*(j+0.5)/512, j=0..511. For each ray intersect all 512 straight physical LCFS segments using 2-D cross products. With tau=0.0001*minimum physical DIII-D grid spacing, deduplicate only positive radii within tau at shared vertices; classify a collinear segment as ambiguous. Use the same parallel/segment-endpoint tolerance and no clipping, skipped frames or angle adaptation.
origin_and_ray_construction.readout: Record 300 O-point coordinates, their strict-inside and minimum boundary-distance values, minimum positive radius, counts of exactly-one/zero/multiple/collinear-ambiguous positive intersections over 153,600 rays, and shot/frame/angle/radii/segment indices for each pathology. Preserve every frame row and source SHA in an ignored frozen run; track a small result summary.
origin_and_ray_construction.all_or_none_gate: Pass only if all 300 true-map O-points are finite and strictly inside their scorer-native C_true, all 153,600 shifted rays have exactly one unique positive intersection, and no collinear ambiguity occurs. A single genuine multiple or zero ray closes this one O-point-origin star-shaped family before log-radius PCA or fitting. This is representation feasibility only, not a score or evidence of predictability from allowed inputs.

cost_and_next_gate.estimate: The frozen centroid version used 1.00 s preparation and 4.24 s for 100 TRAIN shots/300 scorer contours plus ray counts at four workers. Native O-point extraction adds one scorer function per frame; budget under two minutes CPU and below 2 GB incremental memory, then record actual timing.
cost_and_next_gate.if_passes: After root reviews the O-point result, separately freeze one center-plus-log-radius PCA representation: fit only first100 TRAIN frames' log-radius targets, then check a THIRD disjoint100 compact-TRAIN triplet set with the unchanged 0.25/0.5-cell native Hausdorff and topology gates. No use of the earlier second100 as new confirmation, and no direct MLP/full target cache until that independent TRAIN-only representation check passes.
